# Dailymotion

> > Dailymotion is a video hosting and streaming platform offering enterprise solutions for education, content management, and video marketing across web, iOS, and Android.

Dailymotion provides comprehensive video solutions for businesses and creators, including e-learning platforms, live streaming, and advanced analytics. The platform supports multiple formats and devices while maintaining strong focus on security, privacy, and content management.

## Key Topics

- Video hosting
- E-learning platform
- Live streaming
- Video management
- Analytics
- Video marketing
- Studio
- 4K support
- Android
- iOS
- Web platform
- Security
- Privacy policy
- Education solution
- Content management

## Solutions & Products

- [Our Solutions](https://pro.dailymotion.com/en/solutions/): Overview of Dailymotion's video solutions across multiple business sectors.
- [E-learning](https://pro.dailymotion.com/en/solutions/e-learning/): Dailymotion's e-learning video hosting solution with analytics and management.
